introHtml: Cotton poly headwear blends the softness of cotton with the durability of polyester, making it a practical choice for uniforms, giveaways, and outdoor events. The fabric resists shrinking and fading, so your logo stays sharp wash after wash. Whether you need caps for a safety crew or beanies for a winter promotion, this material offers a comfortable fit that recipients will actually wear. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing for a crisp, professional look.
